affected.note: 73,540 air conditioner delivery and installation records (name, address, phone), 3,563 delivery signature images and 553 photos were deleted from the server and may have leaked. No payment data was included.

summary.en: Electronics retailer EDION said a server for a new delivery management system run by its group company Hampstead was attacked on 2022-04-08. 77,656 items of data, including 73,540 delivery records, were deleted and may also have leaked.
summary.ja: 家電量販店のエディオンは、グループ会社Hampsteadが運用する新しい配送管理システムのサーバが2022年4月8日に不正アクセスを受けたと公表した。エアコン等の配送設置情報7万3,540件を含む7万7,656件のデータが削除され、流出した可能性もある。
